title: graph-server: opt-in conditional incl. GraphNodeOp/set seq rollback
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C9h. Crates: jmap-graph-server. Size: M.

Apply the C7 pattern (docs/design/conditional.md §5.1, §7, §9 Other crates; decision 1 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md). register_graph_conditional attaches to every registered graph /set from both register_graph_handlers and register_graph_edit_handlers (GraphNodeOp/set); both register fns unchanged; memory on ScopedState + ConditionalBackend so an atomic rollback restores the op seq; Atomic final-state: edge endpoints after node destroys, caps. Acceptance: precondition, atomic rollback (seq unchanged after rollback), final-state edge-endpoint test; conditional_ready() for each register combination; public-api additions only.
